published.source: PR #54 (client 70425: Judgement of Righteousness 42.9%, Champion of the Light 10 / 20 / 30%, Consecration 4.2% a tick; Concentration Aura; Human, 2026-10-16)

summary: A deep Holy build to Light's Vigil (Holy Shock, Holy Power 5, Consecrated Ground, Divine Precision) with Retribution to Sacred Arbiter, on Seal of Righteousness with no twisting. This copy is on Judgement of the Crusader duty: it keeps the debuff on the boss for the raid instead of getting it from another paladin.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -4.5 s, Light's Vigil at -3 s, Seal of the Crusader at -1.5 s
Judgement of the Crusader at the pull (the duty): 161 Holy damage taken for 40 s, refreshed by the paladin's own melee hits, so one cast lasts the fight; judged again only if it drops
Seal of Righteousness back up ahead of Consecration whenever it is down (right after the opening Judgement of the Crusader)
Consecration on cooldown, down to the last point of mana
Judgement on cooldown on Seal of Righteousness; re-seal Righteousness whenever it is down (no twisting)
Light's Vigil whenever it is not on the target and mana is at or above 30%
Holy Shock on a Vigil-marked target (detonates it, refunds 75% of its mana, starts no cooldown), or on cooldown below 30% mana; Divine Favor goes on a Holy Shock
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Major Mana Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 32 spell power and 18 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Runs short of mana: 3.6% ahead of twist at 120 s (912.6 / 880.8), 2.3% at 180 s, 1.2% behind at 300 s
Divine Precision's hit does not cover Judgement of Righteousness
Holy Shock is worth 148 DPS and Light's Vigil about 91 (measured before client 70425)
A missed Holy Shock consumes the Vigil with no detonation or refund (small at about 1% Holy miss)
Human is best since client 70425 (Ruthless, 2% crit with any weapon): about 3 ahead of Undead (Touch of the Grave) at 180 s
Holy Strike's flat part inside the 50% weapon percent comes from client data, not yet confirmed on the beta
High Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be stale: holding them to their level 30 trend would cost about 1.2%
Seal of Righteousness spell power counted twice on a two-hander (SoD-style 2 x 11%); one coefficient would be about 50-54 DPS lower, and client 70425's 0 on the proc spells about 98-105 lower
The request has the raid's Judgement of the Crusader off, so the debuff comes only from this paladin (standards 23).
notes: Request: paladin__level_60_shock with raid debuff judgementOfTheCrusader removed and the level60_shock_crusader_duty rotation.
